name: Da Nang resort living
summary: Son Tra, Non Nuoc, and the My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap beach resorts when the sea is the trip.
body: Sleep on the sand when the morning swim matters. Son Tra is the peninsula bay. Non Nuoc sits by the Marble Mountains. My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap are the city beach row.
Hoi An is still a ride when the old town is the evening.

properties.name: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort
properties.summary: Private bay on Son Tra Peninsula, reached from the city by car.

properties.name: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa
properties.summary: Non Nuoc beach between the Marble Mountains and the East Sea.

properties.name: Pullman Danang Beach Resort
properties.summary: Vo Nguyen Giap beachfront facing My Khe and the resort line.

properties.name: Furama Resort Danang
properties.summary: Beach resort at 103–105 Vo Nguyen Giap, with rooms and pool villas beside the lagoon pool.
